title: v0.9.71 — See every move in your village adventures

blocks.text: Village adventures now show what each tap does. Picnic dishes land on the table and remain visible after serving. The pond marks nearby swimming directions, adds shell-and-pearl artwork and celebrates collected pearls with ripples and a collection tray. Stars mark the group changed by your last tap and show how many lights are on.

Your final board stays visible after a challenge. Feedback respects reduced-motion settings and does not delay your next move. Puzzle rules, difficulty, supplies, saved progress, crop timers and combat balance stay the same. This update improves clarity and feedback; it does not add new challenges.
村莊小冒險現在更清楚呈現每次點按的結果：野餐料理送上餐盤後會留下；池塘標出相鄰可游方向，珍珠改為貝殼圖示，拾取時有漣漪與收集槽回饋；星光標出上次一起切換的星星，並顯示目前亮燈數。
挑戰結束後保留成果畫面。動態支援減少動態設定，不會阻擋下一步操作。謎題規則、難度、材料、存檔、種植倒數與戰鬥平衡維持原樣。本次改善操作引導與回饋，沒有新增挑戰內容。
